snippet.title: Goodnight, B | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl with a bad case of nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level and explore various atmospheric environments. Solve puzzles, meet wacky characters, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

Wishlist Today on Steam!
